dsDescriptionValue.value:
The VirtualCMB dataset comprises 983 synthetic blurred images, accompanied by their corresponding latent sharp images, depth maps, and camera motion. The images and depth maps are rendered through the Unity engine using five different high-quality 3D scenes, which are readily available in the Unity asset store.
